race.comment: KIRIKAN (4) doesn't win out of turn but is an honest campaigner who rarely runs a bad race. Has placed eight of nine over this trip and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Rates the testing material against this line-up. NOVELA (1) has won two of three this time in work and saves his best form for this distance range. Deserves plenty of thought. NOLAN (2) is one from one over this course and distance and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Top-three contender. Former SA galloper STOKOMO (3) has been thereabouts in all three runs since joining the new stable and shouldn't be ignored. ARCTIC BEAR (5) rounds out the selections in an open race to close out the card.
